caseProtocol: Freeze source snapshots, queries and provisional labels before provider calls.
Run deterministic search with explicit Spanish primary query and English alternate query; no atoms or extra catalog metadata.
Pass top returned exact handles plus the exact same snapshots to one Jev selection per case.
Re-read selected handle using exact fetch; build cited evidence pack.
Compose one short Spanish response per case from only its cited pack; two blind Luna reviewers assess independently.
Report counts and failures by pipeline stage; do not convert provider scores to confidence thresholds.
independentUnit: source document cluster; multiple questions on one source stay grouped
findingsScope: diagnostic only; no runtime, threshold, canonical source, or release changes
